I am a long-time fan of the Wheel of Time. I read [[The Eye of the World]] in 1991 while I was still in college, and looking for new reading material.

I now have three children and I'm a fairly successful software engineer. Rand and the gang have been with me the whole time.

I'm looking forward to November for several reasons, not the least of which is the release of [[Towers of Midnight]]. I've been waiting almost 20 years to read more about the [[Tower of Ghenjei]]!

I was a semi-active member of [[rasfwrj]] (that was a Usenet group, if anyone remembers the awesomeness that was once Usenet..) back in the day before its untimely demise.

Further bulletins as events warrent.
